lead: Lights a person owns for home, garden and outdoors: room fittings and lamps (with design classics as archetypes), decorative lights, torches and lanterns (an enthusiast hobby), and the bulbs, strips, shades and parts that serve them.

depts.note: Tier for everyday lamps; variety for design classics, organised kind → archetype → version.

b.v: CRI mid-to-high 80s or better; 90+ for colour-critical use
b.w: Colour rendering is the first test of any lamp or fitting.

b.v: warm 2700–3000 K for living rooms; cooler for task light
base, arm, joints and shade material
b.w: Stability and adjustability decide how well a lamp lasts.

b.v: original licensed production > later licensed edition > unlicensed copy
b.w: For design pieces, authorised production and date drive value.

s.brief: Turn the flat model lists into archetypes ordered by significance. Table: Tiffany leaded-glass lamp (Tiffany Studios; Dragonfly, Wisteria, Lotus as versions), Akari light sculptures (Isamu Noguchi / Ozeki; table and floor), Panthella (Verner Panton / Louis Poulsen), Atollo (Magistretti / Oluce), Eclisse (Magistretti / Artemide), Taccia and Gatto (Castiglioni / Flos), Bourgie/Kartell, Bouillotte lamp, Andon (Japanese paper floor/table lamp), Lampe Berger only if a lamp. Floor: Arco (Castiglioni / Flos 1962), Toio (Castiglioni / Flos), Luminator (Gilardi & Barzaghi / Flos), Twiggy (Foscarini), Tolomeo floor, Akari floor, mogul/torchiere. Add a tradition entry for Japanese washi lighting (Gifu chochin / Akari) and Tiffany-style leaded glass. Cut IKEA, Eglo, Lindby, Adesso, Trio, Globo SKU lists to a few market-covering brands; fold floor uplighter/torchiere into t. Oil and kerosene table lamps go to the Oil & kerosene lamp kind in Torches & lanterns.

Archetypes in order: Anglepoise 1227 (George Carwardine 1932; Type 75, Type 80, Type 90 Mini, Original 1227 Giant as versions), Luxo L-1 (Jac Jacobsen 1937), Tizio (Richard Sapper / Artemide 1972), Tolomeo (De Lucchi & Fassina / Artemide 1987; Micro, Mega), Lampe Gras (Bernard-Albin Gras / DCW éditions), Jieldé (Jean-Louis Domecq; Signal, Loft), Bestlite (Robert Dudley Best 1930 / Gubi), Kaiser Idell (Christian Dell), Tensor lamp, banker's lamp (Emeralite green shade), gooseneck, TERTIAL as the mass-market reference. Monitor light bars: BenQ ScreenBar as originator plus a few test-winning rivals. Light-therapy lamps belong to H2.
Restraint: tier brands only (Lumie, Philips, Hatch, Beurer for wake-up; a handful of night-light brands). Night light keeps the baby tag; drop novelty SKUs and generic Amazon sellers.

k.brief: alias sunrise lamp, sunrise alarm clock

depts.note: Variety for design pendants and chandeliers; tier for fitted ceiling lights.

b.v: shielded source, diffuser, UGR for panels

s.brief: Archetypes by significance: PH lamp family (Poul Henningsen / Louis Poulsen: PH 5, PH 3/3, PH Artichoke 1958, PH Snowball, PH Contrast as versions), VL45 Radiohus (Vilhelm Lauritzen), Nelson Bubble lamps (George Nelson / Herman Miller, now Vitra/HAY), Flowerpot (Verner Panton / &Tradition), Caravaggio (Cecilie Manz / Fritz Hansen), Akari pendants (Noguchi), Moooi Random, Tom Dixon Beat / Mirror Ball, Foscarini Big Bang / Caboche, Ingo Maurer Zettel'z and Porca Miseria!, Castiglioni Splügen Bräu / Parentesi (Flos), Saliscendi (Stilnovo), billiard/pool-table pendant, paper lantern shade (IKEA PS / Noguchi style). Cut the IKEA and Studio Luminosa SKU lists; ranges listed once.

Archetypes: Maria Theresa chandelier, Murano glass chandelier (Ca' Rezzonico style; Barovier & Toso, Venini, Seguso as makers), Bohemian crystal chandelier (Lobmeyr, Preciosa), Baccarat Zénith, Dutch/Flemish brass chandelier, Genoese beaded, tent-and-bag, birdcage, wheel/corona, polycandelon and panikadilo (faith forms; cross-link F4), Lusterweibchen, Sputnik chandelier, Moooi Heracleum, Venini Poliedri. Add traditions: Murano glass (lighting forms), Bohemian crystal. Chandelier crystals stay in Shades & parts.

Restraint: tier brands covering the market (Philips, IKEA, Eglo, Paulmann, Nordlux, Ledvance; design makers once) ≈5–12 per kind; cut retailer SKU noise. Fold 'troffer' into Panel light types (kind-level, no trade models: drop Trilux, Columbia). Track lighting keeps rail/cable types.

depts.note: Variety for design sconces; tier for bathroom and cabinet lights.

b.w: Faces and make-up need good colour rendering.

s.brief: Wall-light archetypes: Serge Mouille sconces (Applique murale 1 bras, 2 bras; Éditions Serge Mouille), Lampe Gras wall (No. 304 etc., DCW), Jieldé wall lamp, AJ wall (Arne Jacobsen / Louis Poulsen), PH wall, Potence (Jean Prouvé / Vitra), Model 2065/swing-arm sconce, IC Lights wall (Flos), Bumling (Ateljé Lyktan), Wästberg w127. Mirror lights and under-cabinet lights: tier brands only (≈5–8), drop Eglo/Paulmann SKU floods.

depts.note: Mood and novelty lights; receives String light, Decorative lantern and Lava lamp moved in from B4.

b.v: mains vs low-voltage vs battery; outdoor IP rating
b.w: Decorative lights run long, often outdoors.

s.brief: B4 hands over String light, Decorative lantern and Lava lamp (merge them here at assembly; do not duplicate). New kinds to source: Himalayan salt lamp; plasma lamp (plasma ball); fibre-optic lamp; neon light (glass neon and LED neon flex, home use); light panels (modular smart wall panels: Nanoleaf Shapes/Canvas, Govee); party and DJ light at kind level only (types PAR can, moving head, pinspot, laser, strobe; no models; theatre gear is out). Lava lamp archetype: Astro lamp (Edward Craven Walker / Mathmos 1963), Lava Lite (US licence).

k.brief: kind-level only, no models; t: PAR can, moving head, pinspot, beam, wash

b.v: IP44 minimum; IP65+ exposed; IP67 in-ground

b.w: Solar output is weaker and seasonal.

s.brief: Restraint: tier brands (Philips, Ledvance, Lutec, Hinkley, Kichler, Steinel, Nordlux, Louis Poulsen once) ≈5–12 per kind; cut the 80-model Trio/Lucande/Lindby path-light list. Solar vs mains as t types. Floodlight keeps PIR/security types; motion-sensing camera floodlights belong to B8.

depts.note: Enthusiast hobby: forms, makers and modders; organised kind → archetype → version.

b.v: emitter, tint and CRI; driver and firmware (e.g. Anduril); host material; modability
b.w: Enthusiast forums such as BudgetLightForum and r/flashlight.

s.brief: Split k24's 230 models by form; keep ≈5–12 archetypes per kind, never flat SKU lists. EDC: SureFire 6P (originator of the tactical/EDC torch), Zebralight SC series, Hank/Emisar D4 (Anduril firmware), Olight Baton, Fenix PD35, Nitecore EDC, Convoy S2+, Okluma DC1, Malkoff MDC, Muyshondt. Tactical: SureFire 6P/G2X/E2D, Streamlight ProTac/Stinger, Fenix TK, Olight Warrior; weapon-mounted lights (SureFire M600, Olight Valkyrie) are a type here or E4 cross-link. Thrower: Acebeam L19, Nitecore TM/P-series, Convoy C8, Sofirn; LEP lights as type. Right-angle: Fulton MX991/U (US Army L-shaped), Olight Seeker/Perun, Sofirn SP40. Duty & heavy torch: Maglite (Mini Maglite 1984, D-cell), Kel-Lite (originator), Streamlight SL-20. Dive light as kind. Makers go to the brand register once (Fenix, Olight, Nitecore, Streamlight, SureFire, Maglite, Zebralight, Hank/Emisar, Malkoff, Okluma, Sofirn, Convoy, Acebeam, Ledlenser).

k.brief: redistribute k24 models to the form kinds below

s.brief: Headlamp archetypes: Petzl Tikka (originator family; Zoom 1973 as historical), Petzl Actik/Nao/Swift, Black Diamond Spot, Zebralight H-series right-angle headlamp, Fenix HM/HL, Nitecore NU (ultralight), Ledlenser H/MH, caving lamps (Scurion) as type. Cut the 100+ model list. Clip-on light: Olight Oclip, Streamlight ClipMate, a few others.

Gas/pressure: Coleman 200A and Model 220/228 (Coleman Lantern), Petromax HK500, Tilley X246 storm lantern, Willis & Bates Vapalux; collector versions by year/colour. Hurricane: Dietz No. 20 Junior, Dietz 78/90, Feuerhand 276 Baby Special; hot-blast/cold-blast/dead-flame as types. Candle: UCO Original, Japanese gandō. Paper lantern: chochin forms (Gifu, Odawara, Suifu) with a tradition entry. Electric: BioLite, Goal Zero Lighthouse, Black Diamond, MPOWERD Luci; cut to ≈8. New kind Oil & kerosene lamp: Argand lamp, Aladdin mantle lamp, Kosmos/Duplex burner lamps, Victorian parlour lamp, Moroccan/Turkish mosaic and brass lamps (tradition entries) — take oil table lamps from Table lamp.
Restraint: tier brands (Scangrip, DeWalt, Milwaukee, Makita, Bosch, Ledlenser, Brennenstuhl, Stanley) ≈8; clamp, magnetic inspection, tripod and trouble light as t types.

depts.note: Organised by shape and cap; tier brands only (Philips, Signify Hue, Ledvance/Osram, GE, IKEA, LIFX, Nanoleaf) plus test winners.

b.w: Replaces watts as the brightness measure.

b.v: EU energy class A–G; ENERGY STAR

s.brief: Restraint: shape-and-cap kinds with cap types in t; ranges listed once (Philips Hue, IKEA TRÅDFRI, WarmGlow, CorePro) not repeated per kind; ≈5–10 brands per kind. CFL keeps pin-base types (legacy). Strip light: Philips Hue, Govee, LIFX, Nanoleaf, IKEA, Paulmann; rope light as type.

b.v: fitter type (spider, uno, clip, E27 ring); shade size to base
b.w: Shades must match the lamp's fitter.

s.brief: Restraint: shades and bases keep a few brands; cord sets, sockets and chandelier crystals collapse into one Lamp spare parts kind with t types (cord set, pendant cord set, lamp holder, harp and finial, crystal drops/prisms).
